mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, we are looking at 76 degrees with mainly clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park. Tonight, look up at 9:35 PM to see the International Space Station flying from the Cross Plains area toward the southeast near Costco, reaching almost directly overhead. We expect an overnight low of 58 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for students in grades K through 12. Designs must be submitted by July 22 to be eligible for the November election ballot, and community voting will open on July 28. Additionally, the city reminds residents to inspect mailboxes for winter plow readiness to avoid damage claims.

There is plenty to do in town, starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding local activity, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver had their vehicle stuck on a large rock; the incident ended in an arrest for an O-W-I.

Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Salted Double Caramel Pecan. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Butter Pecan.
